title: Audit and correct insect research R3
objective: Quad-check R2 source identity, quantitative parameters, life-stage directness, dataset bytes/checksums, and implementation conclusions; publish a corrected audited R3 without modifying verified runtime code.
acceptance_criteria: Every cited source ID resolves and duplicate records are canonically identified
Every quantitative parameter is classified by directness, life stage, experimental context, and source support
Known source/PMID/title mismatches and life-stage mislabels are corrected or removed
Raw empirical companion bytes and cryptographic hashes are reverified
R3 checksum manifests describe only files actually present in each delivered artifact
Unsupported precision, cross-stage transfer, and pseudo-scientific candidate scoring are removed
